newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Banco de Bogota's '96 net profit soars.
newsitem.headline: Banco de Bogota's '96 net profit soars.

text.p: The net profit of Colombia's Banco de Bogota rose 60.24 percent in 1996 over 1995 to a total of 122 billion pesos, the Banking Superintendency said.
The bank, Colombia's fourth largest in terms of assets, had assets totaling 2.51 trillion pesos by year-end 1996, up 15.12 percent over 1995, the superintendency said in an annual report.
It said Banco de Bogota's liabilities also rose, however, moving up 10.55 percent in 1996 to a total of 1.88 trillion pesos.

No reason was given for the sharp increase in Banco de Bogota's net, but industry sources said it turned a handsome profit on the sale of Cementos Samper in the second-half of last year. ((-- Javier Mozzo, Bogota newsroom, 571 610 7944))
